observed_failure.phase: FlashInfer sampling-kernel JIT after model initialization and graph capture but before generation
observed_failure.error: gcc: fatal error: cannot execute 'cc1plus': execvp: No such file or directory
observed_failure.cause: The optional FlashInfer sampler attempted to JIT-compile a C++ extension, but the ephemeral image does not include the C++ compiler frontend.

correction.meaning: Use vLLM's supported built-in top-k/top-p sampler instead of the optional FlashInfer sampling kernel.
correction.source_evidence: The pinned vLLM source documents VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_SAMPLER=0 as the supported switch that disables the FlashInfer sampler.
correction.scientific_invariance: The diagnostic compares all-vocabulary next-token log probabilities computed before token sampling. The chosen sampling kernel cannot change the compared model logits or adapter-relative log probabilities, and generated token identities are not part of the parity decision.

retry_policy: Retry only the unchanged vLLM half on the same pod. Do not rerun the completed Hugging Face half.
